title: usage.reported
description: Usage delta event emitted by producers and consumed by billing-service.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier; also used as the Kafka partition key.

period.description: Monthly usage bucket in UTC formatted as YYYY-MM.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the usage happened (RFC3339, UTC).

source.description: Producer of the usage event (e.g., tenant-manager, voice-gateway).

calls.description: Delta of calls in this message.

minutes.description: Delta of call minutes in this message.

messages.description: Delta of messages in this message.

storage_gb.description: Delta of storage consumption in GB; fractional values allowed.

api_requests.description: Delta of API requests in this message.

plan.description: Plan code at the time of usage.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for this usage record; duplicates should be treated as no-op per tenant.

trace_id.description: Optional tracing identifier for observability correlation.
